item.title: Why Apostolic Authority Is Not Biblical: A Biblical Response to the NAR
item.description: Is modern apostolic authority biblical? In this episode of From NAR to Christ, Dawn Hill examines apostolic authority in the New Apostolic Reformation (NAR) in light of Scripture.

item.title: True Biblical Revival: Four Marks of Genuine Spiritual Renewal
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how Scripture defines true biblical revival and how believers can distinguish genuine spiritual renewal from emotional or counterfeit movements. Looking at Nehemiah 8–9, Acts 2, and Hosea 6:1–3, this episode shows that real revival is a sovereign work of God that centers on His Word, produces repentance, leads to holiness, and exalts God above all.

item.title: Psalm 32: The Joy of Forgiveness and Freedom in Christ
item.description: Dave Jenkins teaches Psalm 32 in this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, explaining the blessing of forgiveness, the burden of unconfessed sin, and the freedom found through repentance and faith in Christ.

item.title: How Christians Fight Temptation with the Word of God
item.description: Learn how Christians fight temptation with the truth of God’s Word. This episode explains how Scripture equips believers to resist temptation using passages like Matthew 4, James 1, and Ephesians 6.

item.title: Psalm 134: The Journey Ends in Worship
item.description: Psalm 134 concludes the Songs of Ascents with a call to continual and reverent worship before the Lord who blesses His people. In this episode of Walking Through the Psalms, Dave Jenkins explains how the pilgrimage of faith culminates in worship and points believers to Christ our great High Priest.

item.title: Why Christians Should Discard Yoga Mats: A Biblical Response
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Doreen Virtue answers a listener's question about why she discarded her yoga mats after leaving the New Age movement. Doreen explains why many yoga mats contain Hindu, occult, and New Age symbolism, the importance of guarding the Christian conscience, and the difference between neutral exercise and yoga poses rooted in spiritual practices. She also discusses practical alternatives such as Pilates and physical therapy stretching.

item.title: Psalm 33: The Lord Our Help and Shield
item.description: Psalm 33 calls God's people to joyful worship rooted in the Lord's character, His Word, and His sovereign rule over all creation. In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 33 verse by verse, showing how Scripture directs believers away from trusting human strength and toward confident hope in the steadfast love of the Lord.
